{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Remove duplicate patient IDs, keeping the one with the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check the new shape
print("New shape after deduplication:", trial_df.shape)

# Recalculate severity value counts
print("Severity value counts after deduplication:\n", trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel value (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline after deduplication:", (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum())"}
